concurrency_basis: Single-root pilots peak at 576-597 MiB process family on a 16 GB machine. Concurrent behaviour is measured separately before launch; the launcher must gate on available memory.
per_root_interrupt: A root's own cost ceiling may end its search before 56 work units; that is a recorded outcome, not a retry condition.
projection_excludes: final evaluation, scientific gates, analysis, peak-window waits
